description.p: MaqaronyPad edits ordinary Markdown directly with Markdown-native commands and a safe read-only split preview.
Detach the runtime appearance guard cleanly before Qt application shutdown to prevent a PyQt/SIP teardown crash while preserving the accepted live theme behavior.
Correct Windows theme handling and shell colours, set Source/Preview defaults to 11 pt, add Disabled (AppMenu only) and Classic Settings behavior, and clean/flatten the Windows portable build.
Align Modern and Classic local AppMenu presentation, use the root README as Documentation, and correct the Windows portable version validation.
Correct the final AppImage smoke test version assertion and enforce a runtime-version parity regression; editor behavior unchanged.
Correct final-release AppStream metadata ordering and enforce strict metadata validation before freezing; application functionality unchanged.
Promote validated 1.0.0-x17.10 source to final 1.0.0 without application behavior changes.
